title: Yoisaki Kanade — Nightcord at 25:00〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, that's it for the night.
Yaaawn! I'm going to log off and lie down.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm barely awake too. Sleepy time for me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Can I just ask you something before we log off?>
A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Have you decided what you're going to order? I'm getting cola and large fries!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll have oolong tea.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Same for me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'll have...this limited edition dessert.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Of course you're going for that. It's gonna look good on your social media, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What do you care? Press the button and let's order.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway...
Kanade, what's this offline meeting for?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I didn't have any special agenda for it.
I just thought it might be nice to meet up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Knowing each other better might help us make better songs.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Um... I get it about wanting to make better music, but... You called us out here to socialize?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I'm kinda happy you did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that you're showing a real interest in us.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Normally, all you care about is music and making new songs.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd like to get to know you better too, Kanade. Can we ask you personal questions?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yay! First, to get started, let me tell you a bit about myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
She's got a brother one year younger than us.
He's a bit cocky but does anything Ena says like a good boy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Why are you butting in!?
And you're just telling everyone about Akito, not me!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: So your brother's name is Akito?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Guess what, he does music too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's enough about Akito, alright?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's interesting to me too.
I don't have any siblings, so I don't know what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
So, Akito's my younger brother, like Mizuki said...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
We like and dislike the same foods.
So we both like cheesecake and can't stand carrots.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which is weird because in all other aspects we're very unlike one another.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, you have such wholesome family relationships. I haven't even seen my sister in a long time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You have a sister?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she's way older than me and lives abroad, so I don't really see her much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We can text each other whenever, but I don't even remember when the last time we did that was.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Seems like every family's different...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In case you were wondering, my favorite foods are curry rice and fries!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's what you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What's your favorite food, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I always tell people it's my mom's cooking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's what you tell people, but is it really?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't really know what flavors I like.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
You like the stuff that tastes good to you, simple as that, no?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Tastes good?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The thing is, I can't really tell what food tastes like. Like if it's good or bad.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?!
How does that even work?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, like, you can tell when something is salty, or what sort of texture it has, right? Try one of my fries and describe what you feel!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But...they're your fries.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's fine. I'm not going to eat them until they cool down a bit anyway, I'm sensitive to hot foods.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So Ena and Mizuki have siblings, and Mafuyu doesn't know what foods she likes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Kanade! Have some of my fries!
Careful, though, they're really hot!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thanks.
